entities.summary: Marc Bennett Nathanson is an American entrepreneur who served as the United States ambassador to Norway from 2022 to 2024. He is best known for his founding of Falcon Cable, which he sold in 1999 for $3.7 billion. He is a member of the Cable TV Hall of Fame, awarded with Inc.s Entrepreneur of the Year and a former chairman of the Broadcasting Board of Governors. In 2024, his net worth was listed as $2.5 billion by Forbes Magazine  in their annual The World's Billionaires listing.
